analysis: Temporal reference before/at versus after first fish-anchor creation
population_definition: Same TEST patients with documented FishIntroduction and saved nonempty fish-anchor creation in both panels
creation_boundary_rule: First nonempty FishIntroduction-derived anchor creation per patient, in decision-path traversal order; the creating split belongs to before_at_creation
metric: One count per patient–split visit, classified by its window source reference; each stage has its own split-visit denominator
classification_policy: Visited source references are counted even for empty or unavailable windows; availability is audited separately
